canonical_project: Orange Centrafrique Bangui Data Center / Core Network Facility
notes: Digital Business Africa and Ecofin reported that Orange Centrafrique's data center, core network and radio facilities in Bangui were destroyed by a June 2021 fire, and Ecofin later reported operations resumed after 23 days. Orange's Engage for Change CAR page references a Responsable Data Center, indicating a continuing local data-center function. No public MW capacity was found.
